title: Wood farm receives a major update
summary: The wood farm was redesigned for higher rates, lower cost and improved reliability.
description: A major wood farm revision improved collection, redstone timing, TNT behavior and sapling handling.

body.text: Testing placed total output around 160,000 items per hour, with roughly 90,000 to 99,000 wood per hour when using large spruce trees.
Collection lag, TNT timing and sapling placement problems were addressed, while much of the powered-rail system was removed to make the farm cheaper.
